authorization: Implement the separate live ADC12 transport/calibration component and execute one finite fabricated suite. No model adapter or scientific numeric work.

interface.channels: Three uint16_t values, each in [0,4095], ordered voltage/current/temperature; no C bitfields.
interface.time: uint64_t actual interval_ticks per raw sample, never a nominal-rate interval or an absolute timestamp. Zero ticks is permitted. Positive finite seconds_per_tick is caller supplied.
interface.sequence: One contiguous uint64_t next-sequence cursor in the FIFO. Push receives sequence separately; pop derives sequence from next_sequence-count. UINT64_MAX is the exhausted next cursor, never wrapped.
interface.source: One opaque 32-byte source identity retained in the FIFO and matched on every push.
interface.queue: 16 native raw samples, one source identity, next sequence and uint32_t head/count. Expected host sizes are raw16 B and queue304 B; report actual sizeof.
interface.calibration: Caller-injected finite affine offset and units_per_code for all three channels, plus positive finite seconds_per_tick. Finite zero/negative channel gains are allowed as explicit caller choices. No physical calibration defaults.
interface.decoded: Four doubles dt_s, voltage_V, current_A, temperature_C. Atomic take also returns the unchanged raw sample and its derived sequence in separate buffers.
interface.codec: Optional exactly5-byte little-endian V bits0..11, I bits12..23, T bits24..35; upper4 bits must be zero. It serializes channels only, never struct padding or time metadata.
interface.rejection: Invalid arguments, overlap, lengths, range, padding, source, order, queue state/full/empty, sequence exhaustion, calibration and nonfinite conversion do not change the stream or output objects.
interface.execution: Allocation-free, no file/history API, single caller or externally serialized access; not an ISR-safe queue by itself.

cases.name: codec_roundtrip_and_rails
cases.description: 36 single channel-bit positions plus zero, all rails and two distinct mixed vectors; exact canonical bytes and reverse values.

cases.name: codec_rejection_atomicity
cases.description: Each channel at4096/65535, each high padding bit, wrong lengths, null arguments and alias rejection; unchanged outputs.

cases.name: explicit_calibration
cases.description: Exact binary-friendly fabricated coefficients, zero duration, raw rails, zero/negative gains and a uint64 duration above2^53. No physical ADC assumptions.

cases.name: calibration_rejection_atomicity
cases.description: Each coefficient NaN/infinity, invalid time scale, finite product/sum overflow, invalid code, null and overlap rejection.

cases.name: source_order_range_atomicity
cases.description: Opaque source mismatch, repeated/skipped sequence and invalid raw code reject without moving any FIFO field.

cases.name: fifo_capacity_wrap_and_sequence
cases.description: Fill16, reject full, pop8, append8 and drain exact FIFO order with derived sequences; empty rejects unchanged.

cases.name: atomic_calibrated_take
cases.description: Failed calibration retains raw input, sequence and decoded output; success consumes exactly one sample and retains raw temperature/time.

cases.name: alias_state_and_counter_guards
cases.description: Overlapping stream/input/output objects, corrupt head/count/cursor and exhausted uint64 cursor reject unchanged; no sequence wrap.

limits: Raw codes0 and4095 are retained as rail codes. Conversion does not declare them ordinary finite-noise measurements or implement censoring/saturation semantics.
Temperature is retained and converted only. The existing physical model is fixed at25 C; no compensation or physical validity claim is added.
Transport ADC width does not specify residual/statistic precision or replace measurement-noise assumptions.
Tick-to-double and affine arithmetic use host C double rounding; exact large-integer or physical calibration accuracy is not claimed.
No hardware sampling, DMA, clock wrap, interrupt concurrency, target stack/timing or physical ADC performance is qualified.
No model, optimizer, prior, learner, archived observation or truth call/read. No completed-study replay.
